text:
maria: i'm taking over the nightwatch now — quick summary:
- no active incidents. latency and error rates stable across prod regions.
- scheduled jobs: batch-encoder quantization at 03:30 UTC (expected ~45m, uses qp-encoder pool). auth-service canary deploy targeted at 01:05 UTC (small traffic).
- flaky worker: saw sqs-longjobs queue spike to ~120 then drained at ~22:10 UTC; could be a delayed backfill. keep an eye on queue depth and retry errors.
- recent autoscaler tweak (yesterday) lowered scale-up threshold from 70% -> 60% for qp-encoder. might cause quicker scaling (see sophia notes below).

action items:
- if sqs-longjobs depth > 100 for >10m, escalate to infra and consider temporary scale override: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy qp-encoder --replicas=8`.
- if auth canary shows >1% 5xxs in first 10m, rollback to v2.4.0.
- follow up with research on RLHF-sweep regression (PR #342) — leaving that as carry-over.

commands/quick checks:
```
# queue depth
rctl queue metrics sqs-longjobs --window=10m
# check qp-encoder pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=qp-encoder -o wide
# tail recent logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=qp-encoder --since=30m | tail -n 200
```

link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nightwatch

please ping me here or @lee if anything spikes. i'm around until 07:00 UTC, will hand over to lee then.

lee: ack — i'll pick up at 07:00 UTC. i'll keep a watch on sqs-longjobs and the qp-encoder mem usage. if i see sustained OOMs i'll alert here and scale manually.

james: quick Q — where do we track the canary metrics? grafana or the canary-dashboard? i couldn't find the new panel.

maria: canary metrics are on grafana -> "canaries/auth-service" (we recently moved it). here's a direct link: https://grafana.redwood/auth-canary

sophia: FYI — i rolled the autoscaler change yesterday to reduce cold-starts; if you see too aggressive scaling, revert threshold to 70% in the autoscaler config: `configmap/autoscaler-config` key `qp-encoder.scaleUpThreshold`.

sophia: also noticed two pods in us-west auto-restarted once around 21:50 UTC with OOMKilled; logs show a temporary mem spike from a large batch. if this repeats, consider lowering batch size on qp-encoder via feature flag `encoder.max_batch=128`.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED DEPLOY: auth-service v2.4.1 -> canary @ 2026-03-18T01:05:00Z (initiated by @ci-pipeline). rollback window 10m. health checks: /health, 200 for 30s.

maria: noted deploy-bot. will watch the canary window. carrying over: follow up on PR #342 with research tomorrow morning (leaving a comment).

james: thanks — i'll keep slack notifications on tonight. :thumbsup:

lee: thanks @maria, will ping if anything unusual. leaving a short checklist in the handoff doc before i start: scale check, queue depth, canary health, autoscaler logs.

maria: good plan. handoff later at 07:00 UTC. signing off for now but available via pager for urgent stuff.
